structurePatterns: scrim covers full viewport at 52% opacity; centered container with 16px viewport inset
vertical stack: optional icon, title, body, supporting content, action row
one primary action + one cancel; destructive confirmation uses destructive button, cancel is never danger
actions stack vertically on narrow widths; arrange horizontally when labels fit
usageHints: use for short blocking decisions requiring focus; not for long forms
at most one blocking modal at a time — never stack dialogs
scrim and system dismiss follow the same data-loss rule
focus must enter the modal and return to the trigger on close
doNotInvent: no close-X button as the only escape for destructive actions
no gradient or heavy chrome on the container
no success-checkmark dialog for ordinary operations (use Toast)
unknowns: exact max-height for long supporting content derived from viewport policy
